archive_layout: repository-shaped; preserve studies/, examples/, docs/ and root LICENSE

exclusion_policy.internal_qa_images: Browser screenshots and rendered PDF inspection pages are internal QA only. Preserve JSON reports, hashes and explicit omission notes, not the images.
exclusion_policy.latex_temporary_files: Exclude paper aux/toc/out/log/fls/fdb_latexmk/synctex/xdv files and transient build stdout/stderr; retain LaTeX source, final PDF and publication figures.
exclusion_policy.environment_binaries: No Chrome/Chromium/ChromeDriver binary, virtual environment or Python formatter/typechecker installation.
exclusion_policy.generated_package_files: Plans, review lists, release records, ZIPs and package receipts are generated separately, avoiding self-reference.
exclusion_policy.source_evidence_archives: Retain original input ZIPs, exploratory source tarballs and the oasdiff release tar in the full companion. Omit tarballs and large executable binaries from the separate review file list.

installed_prerequisites.node: Observed v24.22.1; required for Workbench, admission, economic model and bundled converter.
installed_prerequisites.python: Observed 3.12.14. Standard library suffices for normalized-JSON comparator/oracle and packaging.
installed_prerequisites.pyyaml: Observed 6.0.3; required to import the acquisition/production driver and for YAML input normalization.
installed_prerequisites.java: Observed OpenJDK 17.0.20; needed only to replay the GTFS validator JAR.
installed_prerequisites.oasdiff: Bundled 1.34.1 executable is Linux x86-64; other platforms require their own matching upstream build.
installed_prerequisites.paper_rebuild: A compatible LaTeX installation plus the Python plotting dependencies used by the paper builders; the completed PDF and figures are included.
installed_prerequisites.browser_recheck: A separately installed compatible browser and automation package; browser binaries are intentionally not included. The demo itself is static HTML.

license_note: Preserve all available original licenses. tr46 0.0.3 declares MIT in package.json but the original installed package has no standalone license text; that absence is reported, never silently invented.
release_boundary: Planning is read-only apart from new manifest files. The final ZIP requires a root-created release record binding the exact plan, final PDF and demo; this local record is not live authentication or repository release qualification.
